summary: Toro Corp., a Nasdaq-listed Cyprus-based Marshall Islands shipping company, filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing agreements, through two wholly-owned subsidiaries, to acquire two MR tanker vessels from unaffiliated third parties. The 2018 Japanese-built M/T Wonder Alasia cost $45.9 million and was delivered September 17, 2026; a 2014 Korean-built scrubber-fitted MR tanker cost $37.5 million, was delivered September 18, 2026, and is expected to be renamed M/T Wonder Atria. Both purchases were funded with cash on hand; no board recommendation or advisor was disclosed. Watch fleet-value accretion and freight-rate sensitivity.
